# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.7 — 9 languages

## 🌍 New

### MediaFlow Studio now speaks your language
- **7 new languages**: Español, Deutsch, Português, Italiano, 简体中文, 日本語 and 한국어 — in addition to English and Français.
- Pick yours in *Settings → Interface → Language* (or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>,</kbd>). Each language is listed under its own name.
- Everything is translated: the tools, the settings, the error messages, the update banner and the "Jobs are still running" message when you close the window.

### Clean text in Chinese, Japanese and Korean
- Each Asian language uses the Windows font made for it (Microsoft YaHei, Yu Gothic, Malgun Gothic), so characters look sharp and natural.
- The sidebar stays tidy in every language: long labels never wrap or push the layout.

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically: click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
